pins.title: Things to Do in the Northern Neck: On the Water
pins.description: Crabbing off the dock, kayaks and a paddleboard, a cedar sauna and a cold plunge, and swimming in a sheltered tidal creek. What there actually is to do on Virginia's Northern Neck.
pins.altText: A private dock on a calm tidal creek off the Potomac River.

pins.title: Crabbing, Kayaking, Birding: Northern Neck Virginia
pins.description: What a day on Virginia's Northern Neck looks like: pull the crab pot at dawn, paddle the creek before the wind picks up, watch the osprey work, and finish in the sauna.
pins.altText: An osprey over a tidal creek on Virginia's Northern Neck at first light.

pins.title: Waterfront Activities on the Chesapeake Bay
pins.description: Chesapeake waterfront activities that need no booking and no gear of your own: crab pot on the line, kayaks at the dock, a sauna a few steps from the water.
pins.altText: Yoga mats set out on a lawn above a Chesapeake creek.
